title: Generalized Star Height Problem
exact_target: Is there a universal finite limit on nested Kleene stars needed to describe regular languages when complement is also allowed?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1459 (MOD-002). CC BY 4.0.

Tom Bourne and Nik Ruškuc, On the Star-Height of Subword Counting Languages and Their Relationship to Rees Zero-Matrix Semigroups, arXiv:1603.06236v2 (2016), Section 1, definitions and the question of generalized height greater than one.
